sections.changelog:
Release 1.3 - November 24, 2025

  • 🎉 NEW: Bricks integration! - Generate complete pages directly inside Bricks using AI! Layouts / Wireframes are hand-made and follow best practices. Available in native, ACSS and CF.
  • 🎉 NEW: Generate images with AI! - You can now generate images inside the usual chat and when in the media library. Use AI to alter existing images or even combine images. Inspired by: https://github.com/WP-Autoplugin/wp-banana
  • 📈 IMPROVE: Overall code improvements.

Release 1.2 - October 01, 2025

  • 🎉 NEW: Custom AI Agents! - Configure your own, custom AI Agents and use them inside the chat, floating chat or in chatbots. Train them with your own data using text, files or web scraping.
  • 🎉 NEW: Chatbots for endusers! - Similar but different to the floating chat, you can now create chatbots, powered by your custom AI Agents. These new chatbots are specifically designed for your customers, whereas the floating chat is design for admins (you).
  • 📈 IMPROVE: New AI models! Select newly released AI models in the plugin settings.
  • 🛠️ FIX: Image API works again! - There was an issue with how images were handled in the code. The AI can now properly fetch and insert images again.

Release 1.1.0.1 - August 18, 2025

  • 🚨 HOTFIX: Fixed drawer chat from floating button. Now opens again and does not load contentmode, which is intended.

Release 1.1.0 - August 18, 2025

  • 🎉 NEW: Content Mode! - In the chatinterface you will find a new mode in the dropdown called content mode. Selecting this will open up a completely new view, allowing you to granularily control content settings, like language, length, focus keywords, context, competitors and more! Use this mode to create truly unique, top-notch content for your site!
  • 📈 IMPROVE: Streaming mode for chat! - Enable streaming in the AI configuration settings and make use of streamed responses for better UX. Also necessary for long content generation to prevent timeouts.

Release 1.0.4 - August 09, 2025

  • 🎉 NEW: New OpenAI models available now! - You can select the newly released GPT-5 models in the AI configuration settings. When OpenRouter is selected, the models are available too.
  • 🎉 NEW: Implemented new DataForSEO tools! - DataForSEO release new AI related endpoints: AI Keyword Data and LLM Responses. Both allowing you to fetch AI related SEO (GEO) data. Learn more here.

Release 1.0.3.2 - June 30, 2025

  • 🛠️ FIX: Show tool results debug again! - Properly store and show the raw tool results in the debug section of the AI response, when using OpenAI.
  • 🚨 HOTFIX: API keys weren't properly fetched and decrypted anymore for new installations. Existing installations weren't affected.
  • 🚨 HOTFIX: Emergency Debug View has proper connection to AI again.

Release 1.0.3.1 - June 28, 2025

  • 📈 IMPROVE: Security improvements! - Some general security updates within the codebase. Proper alignment with WordPress best practices.
  • 🚨 HOTFIX: The emergency debug-view wasn't properly loading on local installs. Furthermore, the styling was broken. Both were fixed with this update.

Release 1.0.3 - June 28, 2025

  • 🎉 NEW: Search the web in real-time! - Allow certain AI models to search the web in real-time. Gather up-to-date data or let AI summarize online articles, and more!
  • 📈 IMPROVE: OpenRouter as a new AI provider! - Use any available AI model from OpenRouter in the chat. Keep in mind that some models might work better than others, depending on what you request.
  • 📈 IMPROVE: Added Tooltips to chat action buttons
  • 🛠️ FIX: Uploaded files persist in chat! - Before this fix, uploaded files where only available to the AI once, within the message that contained the files. Now, they persists throughout the whole chat.
  • 🛠️ FIX: Anthropic tool calling works! - Since 1.0.1 tool calling with direct Anthropic models (not through OpenRouter) did not perform tool calls even when requested. This is now fixed.

Release 1.0.2 - June 25, 2025

  • 🎉 NEW: File upload in chat! - You can now upload files, images and even create custom files on the fly!
  • 📈 IMPROVE: Now using Responses API for OpenAI! - We transitioned from the simple Chat Completions API to the Responses API of OpenAI to allow even smoother agentic use of the chat.

Release 1.0.1 - June 24, 2025

  • 🚨 HOTFIX: - Ensured the AI does not hallucinate breaking changes for file permissions.
  • 📈 IMPROVE: Token optimization on security scans. They now cost less tokens / AI Credits.
  • 📈 IMPROVE: Floating chat button is disabled by default now, so that it does not appear on your pages without knowing. (Mainly on fresh installs.)

Release 1.0.0 - June 24, 2025

  • 🎉 Official Release! - We have developed a new AI assistant for WordPress. It's a tool that helps you with managing your WordPress site, SEO, content creation and more.
  • 🎉 Packed with awesome features! - Chat with your site through AI, get SEO insights, get security audits and an emergency mode when your sites crash, let AI directly apply changes to your site, get performance reports, let AI create a detailed report of your site's content, and more! Many SEO features are directly built into the assistant so you can stay right on your site and get all necessary insights to climb the ranks (goodbye, 3rd party SEO tools!). Though it does not replace dedicated SEO plugins (yet).
